description: Create the voting backend (votingController.js) and the public voting page (views/voting/index.xian), then wire up all 5 new routes in routes/index.js. This is the core feature; FEAT-002 depends on the routes existing first.
steps: 1. Create controllers/votingController.js with 5 named async exports following the exact ESM/pattern of scoringController.js: import { db } from '../models/firebaseConfig.js'; import { collection, getDocs, getDoc, doc, addDoc, updateDoc, query, where, serverTimestamp } from 'firebase/firestore'; import crypto from 'crypto';

2. votingPage (GET /events/:eventId/vote): fetch event doc + contestants subcollection + votes subcollection in parallel via Promise.all([getDoc(...), getDocs(...), getDocs(...)]). Count votes per contestantId into votesByContestant map. Determine votingOpen = event.votingOpen === true. Render 'voting/index' with: title, event (with .id), contestants (sorted by number), votesByContestant, votingOpen, maxVotes (max count value, for bar scaling), totalVotes.

3. submitVote (POST /events/:eventId/vote): (a) fetch event doc; if !event.votingOpen return req.flash('error_msg','Voting is currently closed') + res.redirect back. (b) compute fingerprint = crypto.createHash('sha256').update((req.ip||'') + '|' + (req.headers['user-agent']||'')).digest('hex'). (c) getDocs votes subcollection filtered by fingerprint field (query(collection(db,'events',eventId,'votes'), where('fingerprint','==',fingerprint))). (d) if existing vote found: req.flash('error_msg','You have already voted') + redirect. (e) sanitize contestantId from req.body.contestantId (trim, no HTML). (f) addDoc to events/{eventId}/votes: { contestantId, fingerprint, votedAt: serverTimestamp(), ip: req.ip||'' }. (g) req.flash('success_msg','Your vote has been cast!') + res.redirect('/events/'+eventId+'/vote').

4. voteResults (GET /events/:eventId/vote/results, requireAuth): fetch event + contestants + votes. Build votesByContestant map (count votes per contestantId). Sort contestants by vote count descending. Render 'voting/results' — but since the spec says results are included in the main voting page, simply redirect to the voting page: res.redirect('/events/'+eventId+'/vote'). This keeps the implementation simple; the main voting page shows results to authenticated users too.

5. toggleVoting (POST /events/:eventId/vote/toggle, requireAuth + requireRole admin+organizer): getDoc event. Toggle event.votingOpen boolean (if undefined, default to true meaning we're opening it for the first time). updateDoc(doc(db,'events',eventId), { votingOpen: !current }). req.flash('success_msg', newState ? 'Voting is now OPEN.' : 'Voting is now CLOSED.'). res.redirect('/events/'+eventId).

6. voteCounts (GET /events/:eventId/vote/counts, no auth): getDocs votes subcollection. Build { votes: { contestantId: count } } map. res.json({ votes: map, total: totalVotes }). Set Cache-Control: no-store.

7. Add all 5 routes to routes/index.js in a new '── Audience Voting ──' section, importing the 5 functions from ../controllers/votingController.js. Route signatures exactly: GET /events/:eventId/vote (no auth), POST /events/:eventId/vote (no auth), GET /events/:eventId/vote/results (requireAuth), POST /events/:eventId/vote/toggle (requireAuth, requireRole('admin','organizer')), GET /events/:eventId/vote/counts (no auth). These routes must be declared BEFORE the /events/:eventId/display and /events/:eventId/public routes to avoid any path collision.

8. Create views/voting/ directory and views/voting/index.xian. Structure: standalone page — {{> head }} then <body style='background:#0a0f1e'>, then a minimal navbar (just the ScoreSync logo + event name, no sidebar, no requireAuth). No {{> sidebar }}. Include {{> navbar }} for branding consistency. Use dark theme matching #0a0f1e background, cards using .card-flat class, .badge, .btn-primary, .alert-success, .alert-error from head.xian's existing CSS.

9. Voting page layout (views/voting/index.xian): (a) Header section: event name + 'People's Choice Award ♥' title with heart SVG. (b) Flash messages: {{#if success_msg}}
...{{/if}} and {{#if error_msg}}
...{{/if}}. (c) Voting closed banner: {{#unless votingOpen}}
Voting is currently closed.
{{/unless}}. (d) Contestant grid: responsive grid (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), each card shows: photo or numbered placeholder, contestant number badge, name, barangay, vote count bar (width = (votes/maxVotes*100)%), 'Vote ♥' button (POST form, disabled if !votingOpen). (e) Already-voted state handled client-side via localStorage key 'ss_voted_{{event.id}}' — after DOM load, if localStorage has that key, disable all vote buttons and show a 'You already voted for Contestant #X' banner at top. (f) After successful vote flash, also set localStorage in an inline script that runs if success_msg contains 'vote has been cast'. (g) Auto-refresh vote counts every 10 seconds: fetch('/events/{{event.id}}/vote/counts') and update vote count elements in DOM using data-contestant-id attributes. (h) QR code overlay: a 'Show QR Code' button that reveals a fullscreen overlay div containing a . Load QR library lazily:
acceptance_criteria: POST /events/:eventId/vote with a contestantId adds a doc to Firestore votes subcollection and redirects back to the voting page
A second POST from the same IP+UA fingerprint returns flash error 'You have already voted'
GET /events/:eventId/vote/counts returns JSON { votes: {...}, total: N }
views/voting/index.xian renders the contestant grid; vote buttons are disabled when votingOpen=false
verification: node index.js (start server, visit http://localhost:3000/events/<any-event-id>/vote in browser, confirm page loads without login)
findings: FEAT-002 notes: (1) The Handlebars `lookup` helper must be registered in index.js before results.xian can use `{{lookup votesByContestant id}}` — see voting-plan.md step 5. (2) scoringController.js resultsPage needs to be extended to fetch the votes subcollection (step 6). (3) views/events/show.xian needs hero badge + dropdown items for toggleVoting (step 4). (4) views/scoring/results.xian needs the People's Choice section (step 7). All 5 routes are live: GET/POST /events/:eventId/vote, GET /events/:eventId/vote/results, POST /events/:eventId/vote/toggle, GET /events/:eventId/vote/counts.
